name: Use premium navigation to browse catalogue and open a product
description: Verifies the core B2B discovery flow uses the desktop mega-menu to reach a verified bracelet PDP without retail checkout controls.
steps: Open the Men desktop navigation menu and choose Bracelets
expected: The bracelet PDP shows a sticky information panel with Request a quotation, Request sample and Produce for my brand actions, with no cart or checkout control.

name: Save and review a client shortlist
description: Verifies a product can be saved locally and reviewed from the Favorites shortlist.
steps: Open Bracelets and save one product with the heart control
expected: The saved product appears in the Favorites / client shortlist and the header count reflects the saved item.

name: Use mobile navigation and switch language
description: Verifies the mobile navigation pattern and bilingual control work without relying on hover behavior.
steps: Open the mobile menu and navigate to Manufacturing
Switch the interface language to Turkish
expected: The Manufacturing page remains usable at mobile width and the global interface changes to Turkish without horizontal overflow.

name: Reject incomplete RFQ without fake success
description: Verifies the staging RFQ form blocks incomplete input and never claims an unsent request succeeded.
steps: Submit the form without completing company, valid email and project message
expected: A visible validation message requests the missing required information and no success message appears.

name: Search the verified catalogue and use the digital guide
description: Verifies search and the deterministic OSKA Digital Guide provide useful navigation without inventing catalogue or AI behavior.
steps: Open Search from the footer and search for Panther
Open the OSKA Digital Guide and choose Private label
expected: A verified Panther product opens from search, then the guide opens the Private Label page and presents itself as verified site guidance rather than a live generative assistant.
